Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia and acidemia (low arterial pH, low O₂ saturation, low pO₂), mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, lymphopenia, monocytosis, basophilia, and mild hypoglycemia. Renal function is impaired (elevated creatinine). Red cell distribution width is increased, suggesting anisocytosis. Liver enzymes are low but not clinically significant. Findings are suggestive of acute respiratory failure with possible infection or inflammation, and impaired renal function; urgent clinical assessment is recommended.
